Preaction water deluge system operation test should be made monthly 
The system employs sprinklers, fusible linked type set at 74
C, fed by a
water supply system through a deluge valve, the valve is actuated automatically 
by a thermal detectors rated at 58
C located in the same area of the sprinklers. When deluge valve opens, water 
flows through the sprinklers which may be opened by heat

The first draft initiated by safety eng. Yousri Abd Elhaleem , and the 
maintenance eng. Alaa Elshal. Accepted by safety director eng. Wasfy Nashed. 
Reviewed by chmist Ahmad Elsyed Ebrahem, and chmist Ahmad Abd Allah & approved

items: Remote annunciator panel and system control panel being tested are powered
No alarm of malfunction is indicated on each control panel
Remote annunciator panel switch is in on position (alarm system feeding)
Deluge valve is closed and riser isolating valve and gate valves are open

Sprinklers are installed and plugs in place of nozzles for deluge system test 
 are installed

Connect test detector to the control panel of 
 the system being tested

Place a suitable heat source under the 
 detector ( rated at 58 C) and check that:
 * The fire alarm LED is lighting and acoustic alarm is 
 sounding panel
 * The solenoid valve is energized after 15 seconds 
 after the fire alarm
 * The fire alarm LED on the remote annunciator panel 
 flashes as soon as fire is detected and 15 
 second after the light extinguishing 
 system actuated LED and acoustical alarm signal is given

Press the alarm acknowledge pushbutton on the 
 remote annunciator panel
Check that sounding off alarm on

Press the system pushbutton on reset control 
 panel check that the alarm light is ON, check the valve field condition and 
 provided for according to the case after reseting

Press the reset pushbutton on remote 
 annunciator panel and return in normal condition

Check that no other alarm or fualt indication 
 is present either on remote annunciator panel or on the local control panel. 
 Now the system is in operation condition
